product_increment.title: Connected Add Provider proof
product_increment.intent: An authorized user can understand, initiate, and track one Add Provider journey across Nexus, ServiceNow, Workday, and grounded assistance without hiding unconnected boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: The representative journey is demonstrable on responsive web and native mobile.
ServiceNow case and child-task state are shown through a typed provider boundary.
The named Workday operation is previewed and confirmed only through governed server-side authorization.
Gemma assistance is grounded, permission-checked, observable, and has no transaction authority.
Every fixture, disconnected boundary, failure state, and non-claim is visible.

integration_checks: Build the exact PDS package and Nexus web/mobile consumers.
Run the Add Provider journey against representative ServiceNow, Workday, and intelligence fixtures.
Replace available fixtures with live non-production adapters and rerun contract tests.
Bind the reviewed intelligence provider through integration-owned appfw_runtime/src/chat.rs without transferring that shared path to a leaf lane.
Prove identity, correlation, audit, failure, and no-model-transaction-authority invariants.

lanes.title: Nexus web and native experience
lanes.result: A polished responsive and native Add Provider journey can be demonstrated against typed fixtures.
focused_checks: Build the Nexus web surface against published PDS packages.
Run responsive, accessibility, loading, denied, stale, error, and interruption scenarios.
Run native type, navigation, deep-link, and interruption proof.

provides.summary: The integrated web and native user journey.
The coherent integrated Add Provider proof exposed by the Product Increment.

lanes.title: ServiceNow case projection
lanes.result: Nexus can read the authoritative case and child-task projection and later close the case through a governed operation.
focused_checks: Run typed case and child-task projection fixtures.
Prove permission, identity, pagination, timeout, and stale-state behavior.
Retain correlation and audit evidence without PHI.

provides.summary: Typed authoritative case and task state for Nexus.

lanes.title: Workday governed operation
lanes.result: Nexus can preview and invoke the named Add Provider location operation through the approved enterprise API boundary.
focused_checks: Run the MuleSoft Workday API contract against representative fixtures.
Prove preview, confirmation, delegated authorization, idempotency, and reconciliation.
Label live non-production connectivity separately from fixture proof.

provides.summary: Governed preview and execution of the named Workday operation.

lanes.title: Grounded Gemma assistance
lanes.result: Nexus can explain case state, recommend next actions, and assist task completion through a provider-neutral reasoning contract.
focused_checks: Run deterministic answer-envelope and recommendation fixtures.
Prove permission filtering, citations, fallback, timeout, and malformed-response behavior.
Prove the model cannot authorize or directly execute a Workday or ServiceNow transaction.

provides.summary: Provider-neutral grounded explanation and recommendation metadata.
